nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: command.rs

nodes.name: build_command_with_launch_profile
nodes.summary: Assembles the full CLI invocation (binary, args, env vars) for a given agent/model/mode/repo combination, applying launch-profile overrides and model-specific mappings.

nodes.name: map_claude_model_variant

nodes.name: split_claude_effort

nodes.name: create_parser
nodes.summary: Instantiates the appropriate CLI output parser for a given agent and session id.

nodes.name: CliCommandBuildRequest
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying agent, model, task, resume, API key, endpoint, mode, repo path and additional directories needed to build a CLI launch command.

nodes.name: ClaudeModelLaunchConfig
nodes.summary: Resolved Claude model launch configuration pairing a base model with its reasoning effort.

nodes.name: context_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Builds a condensed textual context bridge from a CLI session's prior chunks, used to prime resumed or handed-off agent sessions.

nodes.name: chunk_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain text content from a session chunk.

nodes.name: chunk_role

nodes.name: build_context_bridge

nodes.name: cursor_usage.rs
nodes.summary: Fetches Cursor CLI usage/quota data for a session by resolving the account's session token and calling the Cursor usage API.

nodes.name: resolve_cursor_session_token
nodes.summary: Resolves the Cursor session token for a given account id, used to authenticate usage API calls.

nodes.name: helpers.rs

nodes.summary: Core streaming entry point that emits a CLI output chunk to the frontend and persists it into the session's event store.

nodes.name: broadcast_streaming_complete

nodes.name: persist_and_broadcast_streaming_complete

nodes.name: persist_streaming_complete_chunk

nodes.name: flush_and_broadcast

nodes.name: clear_live_status
nodes.summary: Clears the live status indicator for a running CLI session/agent pairing.

nodes.name: snapshot_cli_file_edit

nodes.name: persist_attached_images
nodes.summary: Persists images attached to a session's user turn to disk/storage.

nodes.name: cli_binary_id_for_agent

nodes.name: defaults_for_agent

nodes.name: default_profile_for_mode

nodes.name: default_permission_mode

nodes.name: mode_defaults_view

nodes.name: default_args_for_mode
nodes.summary: Returns the default CLI arguments for a given permission mode.

nodes.summary: Returns the default environment variables for a given permission mode.

nodes.name: static_env_to_map
nodes.summary: Converts a static list of key/value env pairs into a HashMap.

nodes.name: CliLaunchProfileModeDefaultsView

nodes.name: CliLaunchProfileOverride

nodes.name: ResolvedCliLaunchProfile

nodes.name: CliLaunchProfileUpdate

nodes.name: kill_running_agent

nodes.name: cancel_session
nodes.summary: Cancels an in-progress CLI session, terminating its process and recording the cancellation reason.

nodes.name: cleanup_cursor_config_dir
nodes.summary: Removes the temporary Cursor CLI config directory created for a session.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root that wires together the session_runner submodules (command building, context bridge, cursor usage, helpers, launch profiles, lifecycle, oauth setup, plan approval, proxy release, session execution, token sync).

nodes.name: oauth_setup.rs

nodes.name: is_cli_oauth_failure_message

nodes.name: chunk_error_message

nodes.name: is_api_overloaded_message

nodes.summary: Checks whether a CLI output chunk represents a retryable API-overloaded error.

nodes.name: is_cli_oauth_stderr_retry_candidate

nodes.name: is_retryable_cli_oauth_failure_chunk

nodes.name: is_cli_chunk_replay_unsafe

nodes.name: sanitize_cli_oauth_env_for_child

nodes.name: write_codex_cli_auth_file
nodes.summary: Writes a Codex CLI auth file to disk for the given account so the CLI can authenticate.

nodes.name: refresh_cli_oauth_for_retry

nodes.name: plan_approval.rs

nodes.name: plan_candidate_path_from_chunk

nodes.name: is_successful_mode_tool
nodes.summary: Checks whether a chunk represents a successful tool call for a given tool name in the agent's mode.

nodes.name: plan_title_from_content

nodes.name: looks_like_buildable_plan_body

nodes.name: create_plan_content_from_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds the plan content payload from a CLI output chunk.

nodes.name: synthetic_cli_plan_path
nodes.summary: Generates a synthetic file path used to represent an ad-hoc plan not backed by a real file.

nodes.name: register_synthetic_cli_plan_approval
nodes.summary: Registers a synthetic plan-approval event for a plan that wasn't written to a real file.

nodes.name: plan_content_from_successful_write_chunk
nodes.summary: Extracts plan content from a chunk representing a successful plan-file write.

nodes.name: register_cli_plan_approval
nodes.summary: Registers a plan-approval event for a session based on a detected plan file write.

nodes.name: proxy_release.rs
nodes.summary: Releases proxy API-key tokens that were checked out for a CLI session once the session finishes or is cancelled.

nodes.name: release_proxy_token_for_session

nodes.name: session.rs

nodes.name: cli_exec_mode_bridge
nodes.summary: Bridges a session's execution mode into the parameters expected by the CLI process spawner.

nodes.name: rule_targets_for_agent

nodes.summary: Builds the full skills content/documentation to write into an agent's rule file.

nodes.name: write_rule_file

nodes.name: convention_targets_for_agent

nodes.name: finalize_plan_revision_events_adapter

nodes.name: compute_multi_session_analytics
nodes.summary: Aggregates SessionAnalytics across multiple sessions into a MultiSessionSummary.

nodes.name: SessionSummaryEntry

nodes.summary: Runs a closure with mutable access to a session's EventStore, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: schedule_notify
nodes.summary: Schedules a debounced frontend notification that a session's events changed.

nodes.name: emit_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds and emits a full event-store snapshot (sorted/filtered/compacted) to the frontend for a session.

nodes.name: pseudo_jitter_ms
nodes.summary: Computes a pseudo-random jitter delay in milliseconds used to stagger retry backoff.

nodes.name: save_events_retry
nodes.summary: Persists a batch of events with retry/backoff on failure.

nodes.name: persist_events_with_retry
nodes.summary: Persists events for a session with retry, wrapping save_events_retry.

nodes.name: persist_runtime_orgtrack_records_async
nodes.summary: Asynchronously persists runtime OrgTrack records derived from session events.

nodes.name: persist_runtime_orgtrack_records
nodes.summary: Persists runtime OrgTrack records derived from session events.

nodes.name: runtime_artifact_session_record
nodes.summary: Builds the runtime-artifact session record used for OrgTrack reporting from a session id.

nodes.name: push_events_to_session
nodes.summary: Core entry point that appends new events to a session's store, updates indexes, schedules notification and persists them.

nodes.name: update_spawning_tool_args_with_persist
nodes.summary: Updates spawning tool-call arguments for matching function names and persists the change.

nodes.name: update_tool_args_by_call_id_with_persist
nodes.summary: Updates a tool call's arguments by call id and persists the change.

nodes.name: EventStoreState
nodes.summary: Shared Tauri-managed state holding all active session EventStores, the session manager, and pending notification flags.

nodes.name: pagination.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for paginated and filtered access to a session's events, including distinct-function counts.

nodes.name: es_paginate_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns a page of a session's in-memory events per a pagination request.

nodes.name: es_paginate_cached_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns a page of a session's cached (persisted) events.

nodes.name: es_count_matching_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that counts a session's events matching given filters.

nodes.name: es_get_distinct_functions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the distinct tool-call function names used in a session.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handler for full-text search over a session's chat events.

nodes.name: es_search_chat_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that searches a session's chat events matching the given search options.

nodes.name: session_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for switching, pinning/unpinning, evicting, and buffering events for sessions tracked by the event-store session manager.

nodes.name: es_switch_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that switches the active session in the event-store session manager.

nodes.name: es_pin_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that pins a session to keep it resident in memory.

nodes.name: es_unpin_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that unpins a previously pinned session.

nodes.name: es_evict_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that evicts a session's in-memory event store.

nodes.name: es_buffer_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that buffers incoming events for a session pending processing.

nodes.name: snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for retrieving a session's current event-store snapshot, raw events, or a markdown export.

nodes.name: es_get_snapshot
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current event-store snapshot for a session.

nodes.name: es_get_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the raw event list for a session.

nodes.name: es_export_markdown
nodes.summary: Tauri command that exports a session's events as a markdown transcript.

nodes.name: store_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for core mutating operations on a session's event store: set/append/upsert/update/merge/clear/truncate, plus repo-context configuration and streaming-state toggling.

nodes.name: es_set_repo_context
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the repo id/path context for a session's event store.

nodes.name: es_set
nodes.summary: Tauri command that replaces a session's entire event list.

nodes.name: es_append
nodes.summary: Tauri command that appends new events to a session's store with merge/backfill handling.

nodes.name: es_upsert
nodes.summary: Tauri command that inserts or updates a single event in a session's store.

nodes.name: es_update_by_id
nodes.summary: Tauri command that applies a patch to a single event identified by id.

nodes.name: es_merge_tool_results
nodes.summary: Merges tool-call result events into their corresponding call events.

nodes.name: es_merge_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that merges a batch of events into a session's store.

nodes.name: es_merge_round_window_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that merges events within a bounded round/turn window into a session's store.

nodes.name: es_set_streaming
nodes.summary: Tauri command that toggles a session's streaming-in-progress flag.

nodes.name: es_clear
nodes.summary: Tauri command that clears all events from a session's store.

nodes.name: es_truncate_before_id
nodes.summary: Tauri command that truncates a session's events, discarding everything before a given event id.

nodes.name: turn_window.rs
nodes.summary: Builds and loads paginated 'turn windows' (grouped user/assistant turns) for a session, including synthetic turn-header and placeholder events and lazy body loading.

nodes.name: turn_has_user_header
nodes.summary: Checks whether a turn already has a synthetic user-header event present.

nodes.name: make_turn_user_header_event
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic user-header event summarizing a turn's user message for display.

nodes.name: make_turn_placeholder_event
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder event representing an unloaded turn's body, to be lazily hydrated.

nodes.name: cache_load_session_turn_body
nodes.summary: Loads the full body events for a single turn from the cache.

nodes.name: load_initial_turn_window_events
nodes.summary: Loads the initial window of recent turns and their events for a session.

nodes.name: cache_load_session_initial_turn_window
nodes.summary: Loads the initial turn window for a session directly from the cache.

nodes.name: es_load_initial_turn_window
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the initial turn window (recent turns plus events) for a session.

nodes.name: es_unload_turn_body
nodes.summary: Tauri command that unloads a turn's body events from memory to save space, leaving a placeholder.

nodes.name: SessionTurnBodyWindow
nodes.summary: A single turn's id paired with its (possibly lazily-loaded) body events.

nodes.name: SessionInitialTurnWindow
nodes.summary: The initial set of turns and events loaded for a session on open.

nodes.name: derived.rs
nodes.summary: Computes derived, display-oriented state from a session's raw events: chat/simulator visibility filters, display status/variant mapping, canvas preview, and simulator preview indexes.

nodes.name: is_live_runtime_resource_event
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event represents a live runtime resource (e.g. a running shell process) requiring special handling.

nodes.name: is_visible_in_chat
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event should be visible in the main chat view.

nodes.name: is_visible_in_simulator_or_messages
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event should be visible in either the simulator view or the messages view.

nodes.name: display_variant_wire
nodes.summary: Maps an internal event display variant to its wire/serialized representation.

nodes.name: latest_canvas_preview
nodes.summary: Finds the most recent canvas-preview-eligible event to show as a live preview.

nodes.name: build_simulator_preview_indexes
nodes.summary: Builds lookup indexes (by event id) used to render simulator previews efficiently.

nodes.name: build_simulator_preview_indexes_from_iter
nodes.summary: Builds simulator preview indexes from an iterator of sorted simulator events, avoiding a full materialized copy.

nodes.name: compute_derived
nodes.summary: Computes the full set of derived display state for a session's events at a given version.

nodes.name: has_thinking_content
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tool/model result contains visible 'thinking' content.

nodes.name: has_visible_message_content
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event has visible message content to render.

nodes.name: sort_if_unsorted
nodes.summary: Sorts a session's events by chat order only if they are not already sorted, avoiding unnecessary work.

nodes.name: sort_simulator_events
nodes.summary: Sorts events specifically for simulator-view chronological ordering.

nodes.name: SimulatorPreviewIndexes
nodes.summary: Precomputed lookup indexes (previews, timestamps, thread ids, function names, display status/variant) keyed by event id for fast simulator rendering.

nodes.name: extractors.rs
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized display data, including tool-call-specific args/result summaries, from raw session events in single and batch form for lightweight frontend consumption.

nodes.name: extract_event_data
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized display data for a single event.

nodes.name: extract_tool_call_data
nodes.summary: Extracts and formats tool-call-specific display data (arguments and result) from an event.

nodes.name: extract_batch
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized display data for a batch of events.
